# Salinova Tech LTD

> Custom software development and cybersecurity consulting for businesses in Kenya and East Africa, combining practical technology education with enterprise-grade security solutions.

## About
Salinova Tech LTD is a technology company based in Kilifi County, Kenya. Founded to bridge the technology gap in East Africa, we combine software development, cybersecurity, technology education, and research under one roof.

## Services
- Custom Software Development (websites, mobile apps, enterprise systems, SaaS)
- Cybersecurity (penetration testing, vulnerability assessments, security training)
- Technology Academy (practical courses in Python, React, Cybersecurity, AI)
- Artificial Intelligence (AI assistants, chatbots, predictive analytics)
- Research & Innovation (blockchain, IoT, smart cities)

## Industry Focus
- Education (student management systems, LMS, e-learning platforms)
- Banking & Finance (core banking integrations, AML, digital KYC)
- Healthcare (EMR systems, hospital management, telemedicine)
